examDefinition: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator is a key Azure service within the management-governance domain. Compares cost of running on-premises datacenter workloads against running in Azure over time
bestPractices: Follow the Microsoft Well-Architected Framework recommendations
Enforce least privilege access using RBAC
Monitor health and telemetry through Azure Monitor
